questions.prompt: In Kotlin coroutines, what does `coroutineScope { ... }` guarantee?

options.text: Suspends until all child coroutines launched inside it complete, and cancels siblings if one fails

questions.prompt: How does `supervisorScope { ... }` differ from `coroutineScope { ... }` when one child fails?

options.text: A child failure does not automatically cancel its sibling coroutines

questions.prompt: Why should you NEVER catch `Throwable` or `Exception` inside a coroutine without rethrowing `CancellationException`?

options.text: Swallowing `CancellationException` breaks structured cancellation, preventing the coroutine from stopping

questions.prompt: Select all standard Kotlin coroutine `Dispatchers` and their intended workloads. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: `Dispatchers.IO` for blocking I/O (network calls, file/DB I/O)
`Dispatchers.Main` for UI updates on Android/desktop main threads
`Dispatchers.Unconfined` as the recommended default for all backend services

questions.prompt: What is a key difference between Kotlin `Flow<T>` and `List<T>`?

options.text: `Flow` is always hot and buffered in memory
`Flow` is a cold asynchronous stream that only executes its producer when a terminal operator like `collect` runs

questions.prompt: How do `StateFlow` and `SharedFlow` differ from a cold `flow { ... }`?

options.text: They are hot streams that remain active and share emissions across multiple collectors

questions.prompt: What does `inline fun <reified T> parseJson(raw: String): T` solve on the JVM?

options.text: Preserves the generic type `T` at runtime despite JVM type erasure
Makes the function run on a background thread

code.source:
inline fun <reified T> isType(v: Any): Boolean =
    v is T

questions.prompt: What is the trade-off of marking large functions `inline` when they don't take lambda parameters?

options.text: Code bloat at call sites with negligible performance benefit

questions.prompt: What does `@JvmInline value class UserId(val raw: String)` provide at runtime?

options.text: Allocates a wrapper object on every call
Provides compile-time type safety without wrapper object allocation when not boxed

questions.prompt: When calling Java code from Kotlin, what is a platform type like `String!`?

options.text: A type from Java without nullability annotations whose nullability is unknown to Kotlin

questions.prompt: Why does `data class Packet(val bytes: ByteArray)` often have a subtle `equals()` bug?

options.text: Generated `equals`/`hashCode` uses reference equality (`==`) for arrays instead of `contentEquals`/`contentHashCode`

questions.prompt: Why is putting a `var` property inside a `data class` primary constructor risky when instances are keys in a `HashMap` or `HashSet`?

options.text: Mutating a `var` changes `hashCode()`, making the entry unreachable in the hash bucket

questions.prompt: Select all ways to improve Kotlin-to-Java interoperability. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Annotate default-parameter functions with `@JvmOverloads` so Java sees overloaded methods
Annotate `companion object` methods with `@JvmStatic` for static Java calls
Annotate `companion object` constants with `@JvmField` or `const val`
Use `suspend` functions directly from Java without adapters

questions.prompt: What does `out T` (declaration-site covariance) in `interface Producer<out T>` mean?

options.text: `T` can only be passed into methods as parameters
`T` is only produced (returned), so `Producer<Cat>` is a subtype of `Producer<Animal>`

questions.prompt: What does `in T` (contravariance) in `interface Comparator<in T>` allow?

options.text: Accepting `T` as input so `Comparator<Animal>` can be used where `Comparator<Cat>` is expected

questions.prompt: Why can `val ro: List<String> = mutableListOf("a")` still change if another reference holds the `MutableList`?

options.text: `List` is a read-only *interface* view, not a guarantee of deep immutability

questions.prompt: In `GlobalScope.launch { ... }`, why is `GlobalScope` discouraged in production Kotlin?

options.text: It has no parent `Job`, bypassing structured concurrency and risking leaked background work

questions.prompt: What does `crossinline` on a lambda parameter of an `inline` function prevent?

options.text: Calling the lambda on a background thread
Non-local `return` from the enclosing function inside that lambda

questions.prompt: What does `tailrec fun fact(n: Int, acc: Long = 1): Long` enable when the recursive call is in tail position?

options.text: Compiler optimization into a loop, preventing `StackOverflowError`

code.source:
tailrec fun fact(n: Int, acc: Long = 1): Long =
    if (n <= 1) acc else fact(n - 1, n * acc)

questions.prompt: What is the performance difference between `list.map { ... }.filter { ... }.take(5)` and `list.asSequence().map { ... }.filter { ... }.take(5).toList()` on a 1,000,000-element list?

options.text: Eager `List` allocates two 1,000,000-element intermediate lists; `Sequence` processes only enough elements to yield 5

questions.prompt: What does `Mutex` in `kotlinx.coroutines.sync` provide that `synchronized` does not?

options.text: Suspending lock acquisition (`mutex.withLock { ... }`) without blocking the underlying thread

questions.prompt: Select all valid reasons to prefer `sealed` hierarchies over `enum class` for domain modeling. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Different cases need different payload properties (e.g., `Success(data)` vs `Error(code, msg)`)
Cases can be instantiated multiple times with distinct data
Exhaustive `when` still applies at compile time

questions.prompt: What does `runBlocking { ... }` do, and where should it NOT be called?

options.text: Blocks the current thread until its coroutine completes; avoid calling it inside `suspend` functions or UI threads

questions.prompt: What does `Channel<T>` provide compared to `Flow<T>`?

options.text: Hot, concurrent producer-consumer communication primitives (like a suspending `BlockingQueue`)

questions.prompt: What does `flowOn(Dispatchers.IO)` affect in a `Flow` pipeline?

options.text: All operators both upstream and downstream

questions.prompt: Why does Kotlin's `Result<T>` type require care when used with coroutines?

options.text: `runCatching { ... }` catches `CancellationException` too, so coroutine cancellation must be rethrown

questions.prompt: What is a key benefit of Ktor or Spring WebFlux with Kotlin coroutines over thread-per-request blocking I/O?

options.text: High concurrency with fewer OS threads because threads are released while waiting on I/O

questions.prompt: Select all true statements about Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP). (Select all that apply.)

options.text: UI can be shared via Compose Multiplatform or kept native per platform
KMP requires rewriting all existing Swift/Java code at once
`commonMain` holds shared business logic compiled to JVM, Native, JS, or Wasm

questions.prompt: What does `by` delegation in `class CountingSet(private val inner: MutableSet<String>) : MutableSet<String> by inner` do?

options.text: Forwards all `MutableSet` interface methods to `inner` automatically, allowing selective overrides

code.source:
class CountingSet(private val inner: MutableSet<String>) :
    MutableSet<String> by inner

questions.prompt: What does `kotlinx.serialization` offer over reflection-based JSON libraries on Kotlin?

options.text: Compile-time generated serializers that respect Kotlin nullability, default values, and Multiplatform targets

questions.prompt: When should you prefer `requireNotNull(x)` over `x!!`?

options.text: When you want `NullPointerException` with no message
When validating an invariant with a clear contextual error message (`IllegalArgumentException` / `IllegalStateException` via `checkNotNull`)

questions.prompt: Match each Kotlin feature to its primary engineering benefit.

columns.label: Type-safe domain IDs without wrapper heap allocation
Zero-allocation lambdas and runtime generic type access
Composition over inheritance without forwarding boilerplate

questions.prompt: What does `withTimeoutOrNull(1000) { fetchRemote() }` return if `fetchRemote()` takes 2 seconds?
Why does Kotlin have NO checked exceptions (unlike Java)?

options.text: Checked exceptions often lead to empty catch blocks or boilerplate wrappers in higher-order/functional APIs

questions.prompt: What does `Sequence` NOT do automatically that `Stream` in Java can do?

options.text: Parallel execution (`parallel()`); Kotlin `Sequence` is single-threaded—use coroutines for concurrency

questions.prompt: What does `kotlin.test` or `JUnit 5` with `runTest { ... }` from `kotlinx-coroutines-test` provide?

options.text: Virtual time advancement so `delay(10_000)` completes instantly in unit tests

questions.prompt: What does `Detekt` or `ktlint` enforce in a Kotlin CI pipeline?

options.text: Consistent formatting, static code-smell checks, and complexity limits

questions.prompt: Select all true statements about `data class` `copy()` and immutability. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: If a `data class` holds a `MutableList`, the copied instance shares the same list reference
Using read-only `List` and `val` properties prevents accidental shared-state mutation
`copy()` performs a shallow copy of property references

questions.prompt: In a layered Kotlin backend service, where should `withContext(Dispatchers.IO)` live?

options.text: Encapsulated inside the repository/data-source layer that performs blocking I/O (main-safety)
